title.zh: 将那牙市陆运署区办公室改设为陆运署A级正式区办公室并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the District Office of the Land Transportation Office in Naga City, Province of Camarines Sur Into a Regular Class “A” District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the District Office of the Land Transportation Office in Naga City, Province of Camarines Sur Into a Regular Class “A” District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng Khu vực Land Transportation Office tại Thành phố Naga, Tỉnh Camarines Sur thành Regular Class "A" District Office, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานเขต Land Transportation Office ในเมือง Naga จังหวัด Camarines Sur เป็น Regular Class "A" District Office และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Kantor Distrik Land Transportation Office di Kota Naga, Provinsi Camarines Sur menjadi Regular Class "A" District Office, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Pejabat Daerah Land Transportation Office di Bandar Naga, Wilayah Camarines Sur kepada Regular Class "A" District Office, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2025/ra_12166_2025.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The district office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the City of Naga, Province of Camarines Sur, is hereby converted from Class "C" into a Class "A" district office.

The Secretary of the Department of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Class "A" LTO District Office in the City of Naga, Province of Camarines Sur, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
